title: Exquisite Family Home Designed for Casual Entertaining in Rome, Georgia
description:
Presented by Atlanta Fine Homes Sotheby's International Realty

For more information go to http://s.sir.com/2m1mvov

Quite possibly the most exquisite home in Northwest Georgia. Rich in the finest quality materials, this home offers unparalleled craftsmanship set against a tranquil backdrop, the Marshall Forest. Friends and family alike are greeted by a gathering porch that opens into a custom floor plan designed for casual entertaining. The main room features gorgeous beamed ceilings and splendid vista views. Rooms flow seamlessly together and are finished with the highest grade materials. Commercial grade appliances, exposed stone and views into the keeping room round out the gourmet kitchen. The main level owner's retreat is opulently designed with a masterpiece marble bathroom and expansive custom closet. The upstairs gentleman's lounge is a true getaway space. An elevator serves all three floors, while a dumb waiter makes transporting food between the two kitchens a breeze. Relax on the lower level playing billiards or watching a movie in the recreation room which opens directly to outdoor entertaining options. A large pool is surrounded by fabulous stonework and the bubbling hot tub waterfall completes the ideal ambiance. A courtyard meditation garden and paved sports court offer downtime options for every lifestyle. Unending privacy exists on this gated 23 acre property. Featured in many publications, this home is worthy of the highest consideration.
